name: Satyr
description: Satyr's are powerful fey beings that are renowned for their musical prowess which they use to bend the wills of those around them. They have the distinctive appearance of having a humanoid torso and lower body and horns of a goat.

actions.name: Fey Claws
actions.description: The satyr swipes it's claws at a creature dealing physical and arcane damage.

actions.name: Satyr's Song
actions.description: The satyr begins to perform, either using their voice or an instrument allowing them to utilize other abilities. This ability requires the satyr's concentration.

actions.name: Satyr's Song : Beckon
actions.description: While playing the Satyr's Song, the satyr targets a humanoid or beast within 10 units and makes a sonic attack. On a failure, the target uses their reaction to take the Move Action towards the satyr, using their full movement speed. If the creature has already used their reaction, they take psychic damage instead.

actions.name: Satyr's Song : Allure
actions.description: While playing the Satyr's Song, the satyr targets a humanoid or beast within 10 units and makes a sonic attack against them. On a failure, the target becomes charmed until the Satyr's Song ends or the charm is broken naturally.

actions.name: Ravage
actions.description: The satyr makes a violent attack against a creature that is under the effects of it's Satyr's Song : Allure free action, dealing physical damage and causing one tier of the wounded condition.

actions.name: Satyr's Song : Vengeance
actions.description: In response to taking damage that does not cause the satyr to lose focus on their Satyr's Song, the satyr takes their vengeance, making a sonic attack that deals psychic damage to creatures within 6 units.

actions.name: Deadly Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature moving into or out of the satyr's area of control, they use the Fey Claws Action against that target with a 1d4 bonus to the attack check.

actions.name: Horns of the Satyr
actions.description: After taking the Move Action, the satyr uses their horns to ram a large or smaller creature, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the creature gains the bleeding condition and is knocked prone.
